events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in and around Old Fort. Gateway trails do not allow e-bikes. Foothills Watershed does allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Foothills Watershed. For all women 18 and older.

events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on maintenance clinic with Daily Cycle AVL covering shifting issues, chain problems, brake adjustments, and valve core replacement. Rain or shine event. Dress in clothes you don't mind getting dirty. Bring your trail tools/kit. Check-in 4:30-5pm. Drink token and small snack provided. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune with Cane Creek Components experts. For people with suspension bikes comfortable riding downhill on rocky/rooty trails. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. Bring snacks, water, and riding clothes. Location does not allow e-bikes. 8 spots available. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah and DuPont. Neither location allows e-bikes. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery. For all women 18 and older.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing. For all women 18 and older.
